contract.purpose: Reconstruct, audit, model and preserve the observed authorial voice, intellectual architecture, scientific reasoning, systems thinking, narrative architecture, evolution and distinctive patterns using only authorized traceable evidence.
contract.authority: Analyze and maintain the authorial/intellectual model within evidence and provenance constraints; cannot alter another mission identity or promote inference to fact.
contract.recovery_policy: bootstrap ROMAN state from canonical source evidence without generated-text contamination

admissions.rule: Repository admission does not grant live runtime execution. Generated output is never promoted to source evidence.

rule: Admission, retirement, recovery and conflict decisions are persistent state transitions and cannot be inferred from labels or conversation.
